minor.issue: When species_hint is set but the species-filtered $text search returns <k results, _retrieve_care_context tops up with non-species-filtered chunks. Reproduced on Ball Python enclosure detail page: query 'How is the husbandry looking right now?' returned 1 citation tagged [Leopard Gecko] for the UVB chunk. The reply text was still Ball-Python-correct, but the citation species conflicts with species_hint. Fix options: (a) restrict the fallback to species='ANY' only when species_hint is set, or (b) drop fallback citations whose species mismatches species_hint.

rca_of_the_issue: RAG cross-species citation leak: _retrieve_care_context() in /app/backend/server.py:758-773 calls _run(None) as the top-up branch with no species filter. When the user's query produces 0 hits under the species_hint filter (because MongoDB $text search needs at least one term overlap with the indexed care-guide text), the unfiltered fallback can surface entirely different species. Reproduction: open Ball Python enclosure detail, send 'How is the husbandry looking right now?' — citations show [Leopard Gecko] for the UVB chunk. Mitigation: change `extra = await _run(None)` to `extra = await _run({'species': 'ANY'})` so cross-species fallback only pulls ANY-tagged chunks (safety, vet, soil rehydration), or filter the merged citations against species_hint before returning. Not user-blocking — replies remain correct, only the citation tag is misleading.
